description: Full 16:9 source-only FantasyDisk Atlas page mockup, premium dark fantasy D&D dragon-forged style matching the accepted Meta40 hollow gold frame family. No text, no letters, no numbers, no pseudo-text, no runes shaped like writing, no logo, no watermark. Keep the major panel interiors dark, calm and empty. Outer ornament must stay outside the safe interior. Show exactly one large free core socket near the lower middle of the graph, exactly three clearly separated weapon rays rising from that core, exactly six purchasable sockets on each ray including a stronger ornate final socket at each endpoint, and exactly two smaller hidden side-spur sockets attached laterally to the outer rays. Draw thin restrained constellation connectors only between the intended sockets. All three finals have equal visual authority and no exclusive/activation-toggle motif. Preserve a left class selector rail, a right empty dossier panel, a smaller right progress/legacy panel, and a bottom footer with a wide 420-family reset plate on the left and a separate legend zone on the right. No keystone toggle. Decorative metal, dragon ornaments, gems, spikes, seams, highlights and smoke must not enter any empty content interior or socket center. Strict, brutal, epic, premium, readable, restrained rather than noisy.
